instructions.manual_exchange_notice: Upload this CHATGPT_PACKAGE.json independently in a fresh chat. VideoHoarder never uploads data automatically.

quality_rubric.grounding: Every material transcript-derived conclusion cites canonical segment_ids.
quality_rubric.coverage: Process every exact VIDEO_ID and every requested feature.
quality_rubric.semantic_synthesis: Write semantic summaries that consolidate meaning, argument, method and implications; do not concatenate or lightly rewrite transcript lines.
quality_rubric.timeline: Create boundaries only when the substantive topic changes; merge adjacent fragments about the same point.
quality_rubric.claims: Extract all consequential factual, medical, safety, financial, legal, causal, quantitative and recommendation claims; grade risk and external-verification need.
quality_rubric.entities: Perform named-entity recognition, merge aliases, type entities using the controlled list, and omit generic nouns.
quality_rubric.taxonomy: Use only controlled categories and canonical non-promotional tags.
quality_rubric.editorial: Make assessments specific to this video's evidence, value, limitations and audience; never reuse boilerplate.
quality_rubric.consistency: Use the same canonical evidence across summaries, timeline, claims, intake and editorial assessment.
quality_rubric.specificity: Preserve useful names, quantities, steps and qualifications; avoid generic filler.
quality_rubric.uncertainty: Distinguish source claims, supplied support, interpretation and external-verification needs.
quality_rubric.comments: Cluster only structured supplied comment records and report total, included count and sampling limitations; popularity is not factual verification.
quality_rubric.clips: Select only self-contained clips lasting 30-180 seconds, with valid non-overlapping timestamps and a video-specific purpose.

instructions.instructions: Use only the evidence embedded in this independently processed package and obey response_schema.feature_contracts, controlled_taxonomy, and formal_json_schema. Process every exact VIDEO_ID and return one final JSON object with no prose or markdown. All features must use the same canonical sentence-level transcript segments. Do not claim that you watched or listened to a video. Produce semantic synthesis rather than extractive transcript rewrites. Build timelines from meaningful topic boundaries. Perform complete risk-aware claim extraction and proper named-entity recognition. Make editorial_assessment.v1 a video-specific ChatGPT's Take, not boilerplate. Cite canonical transcript segment_ids for transcript-derived conclusions. Downgrade confidence for partial/low evidence. If canonical segments are absent, do not produce transcript-derived summaries, timelines, claims, transcript-derived entities, or clips; metadata/comment-derived fields must identify their source and unsupported fields must be empty/unknown with the limitation. metadata.description:
Which are the best natural makeup products available in the Indian market? 

Buy Mamaearth Vitamin C Face wash and Face mask - https://bit.ly/3ndF3Bg
(Apply discount coupon FITTUBER21 to get 21% off)
Buy from Amazon - https://amzn.to/3rryGwp

For a modern woman, an integral part of her grooming kit is her makeup essentials. A primer, foundation, lipstick, kajal, mascara, eye liner, blusher and so on. But do you know what goes in making your favourite makeup products? Loads of harsh chemicals to say the least. Using such products on a regular basis prematurely ages the skin and causes myriad skin issues. But don’t worry. It is time to throw these toxic products away as I share with you the natural makeup products available in the Indian market. 

00:58 - #7 Natural Make up Product - Foundation - Foundation is a liquid or powder makeup applied to the face to create an even, uniform color to the complexion and enhance the natural skin tone.
02:00 - #6 Natural Make up Product - Primer - Any make up generally starts with a primer. And rightly so, a primer smoothens the pores of the skin and creates an even layer on top of it for foundation to glide onto. So a good primer creates a solid base for makeup.
